items.title: [DC] snorlax01@🔸guides: GLotan   Mob Waves w/ base Ramona - Equip GLotan Posse - Keyflare Rouse GLotan
items.summary:
GLotan 

Mob Waves w/ base Ramona
- Equip GLotan Posse
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan 
- Play GLotan Rouse 
- Use Cetus-Devouring Storm on base Ramona 
- L if no Long Blade, play Defense to Draw it
- L or use base Ramona Exalt to obtain it from Draw / Discard Pile
- Play Strikes to reduce the Cost of Long Blade, ideally Short Blade
- Play Long Blade last  

Mob Waves w/ Cassiah
Version 1
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan 
- If no Long Blade / Short Blade
- Use The Mountain's Resolve on GLotan 
- L if you still do not have Long Blade, play Defense to Draw it out 
 - if you can, play Telekinesis while Ultra Space is empty
- L or use Telekinesis to grab Short Blade from the Ultra Space
- Play whatever Strikes that you have available, (ideally Short Blade)
- Play Long Blade at the very end 

Version 2
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan 
- If you do have Long Blade (or Defense) / Short Blade
- Use The Mountain's Resolve on Cassiah to obtain Telekinesis 
- L if you do not have Long Blade, play Defense to Draw it out 
 - Ideally pllay Telekinesis while Ultra Space is empty
- L or use Telekinesis to grab Short Blade from the Ultra Space
- Play whatever Strikes that you have available, (ideally Short Blade)
- Play Long Blade at the very end 

Exalt 
- Play Short Blade 3x
- L once marked Gold, play Short Blade into Long Blade to combine and fuse into Whalefall
- L which in Turn, would also unlock your Exalt
- If incapable of using Exalt (or you want to use OE instead,) play Deadly Duel to use the Aliemus of her Allies to Battery herself
- Use Exalt / OE, only when you are guaranteed to die due to a lot of Damage

PChaos Posse
- Whenever possible, prioritize  Triple Posse (Triphase Relevation) over Double-Play (Dual Recurrence) 
- Prioritize Damage Buffs > Arith > Search > Aliemus > Draw
- To generate Keyflare, play as much Cards as possible from your Awakeners for the first time in each Turn

items.summary:
大家好，我把奥尔拉活动开场动画的诗录制了，并且汉化，虽然对中文有点儿不熟，希望大家还能欣赏

法文
> **Fleurs pour le Printemps**
> ﻿
> Prends ma main, vous dites
> Lorsque nos doigts se touchent,
> tu me donnes un jardin
> ﻿
> Dans notre petit royaume
> Tu soutiens toutes les épines pour moi
> Accepte ce poèm pour lequel le printemps
> consacre au jardin
> Dans nos vies désolées,
> les roses s'installent d'un rouge ardent
> La pluie,
> c'est l'adieu du printemps au jardin
> Quand nous nous rencontrerons
> Veux-tu ramasser les fleurs
> Pour échanger les derniers poèmes avec moi
> ﻿
> —Horla

中文
> 《赏春之花》
> ﻿
> 您说，握我的手
> 当我们的手指接触，
> 你给我一个花园
> ﻿
> 在我们的小王国里
> 你为我撑起所有荆棘
> 接受吧，这首使春天
> 供奉于花园的诗
> 在我们荒凉的生活中，
> 玫瑰居在红色如火烈
> 雨，
> 是春天对花园的告别
> 当我们再次相见
> 你会不会摘花
> 为了与我交换最后的诗
> ﻿
> —奥尔拉
